settings.text: The ArcticPro keeps our whole living room at 21° silently. Install team was in and out in three hours. Receipt-style invoice was a nice touch!
settings.name: Marloes V.

settings.text: Ordered the FlowMaster HRV after the free survey. CO₂ levels dropped instantly and the heat recovery is paying for itself.
settings.name: Daan K.

settings.text: Portable Nomad 12K was plug-and-play for my home office. App control is genuinely useful. Only wish it were a touch quieter at night.
settings.name: Priya S.

settings.text: The Halo ceiling fan looks premium and the DC motor sips power. Maintenance plan means I never think about it. Top supermarket-of-climate concept.
settings.name: Tom B.
